description: Recovered fx2-cmix source build packaged with Python stdlib lzma bootstrap: cmix.xz plus english.dic.xz are counted by lib/driver.py, decompressed to a process-local temp cache, then used through the verified dictionary-pretrained -c/-d path.
build: make CC=g++ FP_FAST_FLAG='-fno-strict-aliasing' ZEN2=1 STRIP_FLAG='-s' CFLAGS_DEFINES='-DSEED=923 -DUPDATE_LIMIT=3000' clean cmix
notes: Uses the dictionary-pretrained -c/-d path. The local PPMD mmap remap was fixed so remapping preserves internal pointer stability.
